news.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon for faster complex agent tasks
news.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon with a one-million-token context window, multimodal inputs and access through its Gemini API and selected apps. Google lists API token rates and performance results.
news.why_it_matters: Adds a new latency-versus-capability choice for coding, multimodal review and agent pipelines.
news.caveat: Benchmark rankings are partly company-reported; independent evaluation settings, plan access, effective costs and rollout vary.

news.title: AWS adds managed distributed KV caching to self-hosted inference
news.summary: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey introduced a managed key-value cache tier for LLM prefill states, integrated through LMCache with vLLM, SGLang and TensorRT-LLM.
news.why_it_matters: Reusable prefill work can reduce time to first token when prompts or prefixes repeat across distributed GPU workers.
news.caveat: AWS's up-to-40-percent inference-cost and up-to-80-percent TTFT improvements are workload- and cache-hit-rate-dependent vendor measurements; added network and cache costs matter.

news.title: SageMaker enables region-policy-aware overflow inference routing
news.summary: AWS announced general availability of cross-Region inference routing for real-time SageMaker endpoints and described Salesforce's multi-Region deployment.
news.why_it_matters: Eligible requests can use spare model-serving capacity without rewriting the calling application, while residency-constrained requests remain local.
news.caveat: Destination models and artifacts must be synchronized; the router does not create GPU capacity and regional, IAM and cost policies require verification.

news.title: Anthropic prices its IPO ahead of intended November 19 listing
news.summary: Anthropic's November 18 statement priced 980 million Class A shares at $83 each and said Nasdaq trading under ANT was expected to begin November 19.
news.why_it_matters: The prospective listing is a major AI-capital-market event with implications for financing and disclosures.
news.caveat: The stated trading and closing dates were expectations at announcement, not proof that trading or closing had occurred.

news.title: OpenAI details staged controls across frontier-model lifecycle
news.summary: OpenAI described sandboxing during research, alignment testing for internal use, safety cases, monitoring, and external-release safeguards.
news.why_it_matters: Offers a concrete account of how a frontier lab says it links pre-deployment evaluation to operational safeguards.
news.caveat: These are organizational claims and procedures, not an independent audit or proof that every failure mode is mitigated.

news.title: OpenAI adds self-service API project data-residency choices
news.summary: OpenAI's Enterprise and Edu release notes describe fixed-region project selection and per-request residency for eligible Global API projects, without a separate Zero Data Retention application.
news.why_it_matters: Regional storage and processing controls matter for jurisdiction-sensitive AI deployments.
news.caveat: Eligibility, supported models/endpoints, data storage versus processing, UAE options and pricing differ; this is not universal residency coverage.

news.title: GitHub launches team-level Copilot plugin defaults
news.summary: GitHub now lets authorized team maintainers and organization owners select approved Agent Plugins for team defaults in supported Copilot clients.
news.why_it_matters: Reduces per-developer setup for shared agent tools while retaining higher-level policy controls.
news.caveat: Applies to supported Business/Enterprise setups and direct team members; child teams do not inherit the configuration.

news.title: Copilot previews eight additional verified service connectors
news.summary: GitHub announced eight more GitHub-verified MCP service connections, including Supabase, Box and Calendly, in a public preview.
news.why_it_matters: Broadens the authorized external systems coding agents can consult and operate through.
news.caveat: Preview access, per-service permissions, connector capabilities and policy restrictions vary; verification does not eliminate prompt-injection risk.

news.title: GitHub CLI previews event-driven pull-request waiting
news.summary: GitHub CLI v2.105.0 added gh event listen for streaming pull-request changes and checks into agent and script workflows instead of polling.
news.why_it_matters: Can make coding-agent orchestration more reactive and reduce idle repeated API requests.
news.caveat: Event Streams require preview access and may change; not all users can enable the commands.

news.title: vLLM discloses request-template trust-gate bypass
news.summary: A vLLM maintainer advisory describes how the /v1/systemone endpoint could route caller-supplied chat-template kwargs around a template trust check for supported model architectures.
news.why_it_matters: Operators exposing the affected structured-decision endpoint should review their versions and trusted caller boundaries.
news.caveat: This is a disclosed vulnerability, not evidence of exploitation. The advisory's machine-readable affected-range field includes 0.34.0 while its explanatory text says 0.34.0 is patched; operators should verify release details.

news.title: OVHcloud announces Europe-hosted AI cloud offerings
news.summary: Reuters reported OVHcloud's launch of 55 European-hosted cloud and AI products, including Blackwell-powered offerings and a work suite with AI assistants.
news.why_it_matters: Regional cloud infrastructure and data-location promises are increasingly important to European organizations.
news.caveat: Capacity figures and cost improvements were attributed to company statements; 60,000-chip potential capacity is not verified installed inventory.

news.title: Reuters reports tighter TSMC chip-manufacturing restrictions
news.summary: Reuters cited people familiar with TSMC guidance saying affected orders from Chinese chip designers at 16 nm and below now require US export licenses, following new federal rules.
news.why_it_matters: Advanced process access and high-bandwidth memory packaging affect where frontier AI hardware can be produced.
news.caveat: This is source-based reporting rather than a direct public TSMC statement; exceptions, individual license decisions and future effects remain uncertain.

news.title: ECB supervisor flags growing bank lending to data centres
news.summary: Reuters quoted ECB banking supervisor Claudia Buch reporting data-centre exposure at roughly 1.2-1.3% of euro area banks' corporate exposure, but a quickly rising share of new lending.
news.why_it_matters: AI infrastructure growth creates financing concentration and electricity-demand risks to monitor.
news.caveat: Figures concern the ECB's stated bank-exposure scope, not all global AI infrastructure financing or an immediate crisis.

news.title: Google expands MLPerf Training v6.1 TPU and GPU evidence
news.summary: Google Cloud's November 16 training benchmark post, updated November 18, reports reference-checkpoint-to-target measurements for Ironwood TPU and Blackwell GPU systems, including agentic reinforcement learning.
news.why_it_matters: Makes scaling and hardware orchestration comparisons possible using named standardized benchmark settings.
news.caveat: Benchmark times are not full from-scratch frontier training costs; results depend on precise workloads, quality criteria, and tuning.

technologies.name: Gemini 4 Neon
technologies.explanation: Hosted multimodal reasoning and coding model with an announced one-million-token context window and configurable inference service.
technologies.conditional_advantage: When a workflow needs rapid multistep tool work with long mixed-media context, this model may reduce latency or per-task cost relative to a larger model; compare per-task quality first.
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Cloud API and supported Google/Copilot clients; local weights or self-hosting not established.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Hosted proprietary model; redistribution rights and local weight licensing not available from release.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Staggered release across API, subscriptions and GitHub Copilot; model availability depends on region and plan.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Google lists $3 per million input and $15 output tokens and cache discounts at release; confirm current tier and platform billing.

technologies.name: ElastiCache distributed KV caching for LLM inference
aliases: Distributed KV caching with ElastiCache for Valkey
technologies.explanation: Managed remote store for transformer KV cache blocks, allowing inference workers to reuse previously computed prefill context via LMCache.
technologies.conditional_advantage: High repeated-prefix/cache-hit workloads can avoid expensive prefill recomputation and lower TTFT; low reuse workloads may not benefit.
tradeoffs: Cache storage cost and eviction policy
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Requires compatible self-hosted inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM with LMCache and supported ElastiCache nodes plus network.
technologies.license_uncertainty: ElastiCache is managed proprietary service; LMCache connector is open source but the exact deployment license and dependencies must be checked separately.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: AWS reports general availability November 18, 2026; regional coverage and engine compatibility require live validation.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Cache node and network fees apply; vendor reductions are benchmark-specific, not guaranteed.

technologies.name: Amazon SageMaker AI cross-Region inference routing
technologies.explanation: Policy-controlled managed routing of real-time inference requests across authorized endpoints in eligible AWS regions/accounts.
technologies.conditional_advantage: When regional traffic is uneven and destination capacity is idle, eligible overflow traffic may be served without modifying the application call path.
tradeoffs: Need synchronized model artifacts and scaling policies
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints and allowed commercial Regions; endpoint owner policies, CloudWatch and CloudTrail; does not add GPU compute capacity.
technologies.license_uncertainty: Managed AWS service, not an open-source inference router; contractual terms apply.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: AWS says GA November 18 in supported commercial regions; verify eligible models and regional service constraints.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: Endpoint capacity, egress and inter-region data-transfer pricing vary; no general savings guarantee.

technologies.name: GitHub CLI Event Streams (gh event listen)
technologies.explanation: CLI command in gh v2.105.0 that consumes streamed repository/pull-request events and emits JSON notifications to scripts and agents.
technologies.conditional_advantage: For automation waiting on code reviews or CI checks, event-driven notifications avoid repetitive API polling and can lower idle latency.
technologies.hardware_runtime_constraints: GitHub CLI v2.105.0+, authenticated GitHub.com Event Streams preview access; internet connectivity.
technologies.license_uncertainty: GitHub CLI has an open source codebase, but Event Streams availability and service terms are controlled by GitHub.
technologies.availability_uncertainty: Preview with access waitlist; command existence does not imply entitlement.
technologies.pricing_uncertainty: No independent fee schedule verified for this preview; API and plan limits could apply.

terms.name: Distributed KV cache tier
terms.definition: A shared memory or storage layer that holds previously computed attention key/value tensors so different inference workers can reuse prefill states.
terms.mechanism: Cache identity keys associate compatible token prefixes, model versions and attention states with chunks; workers fetch reusable states rather than recomputing all prompt tokens.
terms.example: Two agent workers with the same long instruction prefix load a remote cache block before generating different responses.
terms.caveat: Reuse requires correct prefix, model and attention-state compatibility; transfer overhead or privacy boundaries can erase gains.

terms.name: Cross-region inference routing
terms.definition: Directing an inference request to an authorized serving endpoint in another cloud region based on capacity, availability, policy and residency requirements.
terms.mechanism: An authorized routing service inspects eligibility and endpoint health, selects an alternative provisioned endpoint and records where a request executed.
terms.example: An EU-only request stays in an approved EU region while eligible traffic may overflow to a second allowed region with spare capacity.
terms.caveat: Routing does not provision capacity or guarantee legal compliance; synchronization, latency, costs and exact processing region matter.

terms.name: Event-driven agent orchestration
terms.definition: An agent workflow that resumes or changes tasks when an external state-change event arrives rather than continuously checking for updates.
terms.mechanism: The agent subscribes to structured events, persists task state and triggers the relevant next action on a matching notification.
terms.example: A coding agent waits for a pull-request review event and only then edits code or submits another review.
terms.caveat: Event delivery and retries can duplicate or miss messages; idempotency, authentication and backoff still matter.
